definitions.B1: p_hat(t+tau)=p(t)+v(t_k*)*tau; k* latest of 6 history samples with valid Task 2 causal velocity (backward search); none -> invalid, no fallback
definitions.B2: least squares on valid history samples with mean-centred actual timestamps; p_hat(t+tau)=p(t)+b*tau; needs >=3 valid samples, span >=0.2 s (1e-9 s tol), centred variance >1e-6 s^2
definitions.minADE@K/minFDE@K: best-of-K oracle; equal to ADE/FDE for K=1
definitions.aggregation: window-weighted primary; track-weighted separately; population std (ddof 0); common-window comparison

window_weighted.note: each evaluated window has weight 1; overlapping windows are NOT independent samples

track_weighted.note: each track has weight 1 (mean over its windows first)

runtime_s.note: offline CPU timing on one machine; not a real-time claim

regression.note: started before the final manifest-only edit (torch version via metadata); tests/phase5 re-run on final code: 82 passed

defects_found_and_fixed_in_new_code: HistoryInput froze caller arrays (np.asarray without copy) -> now copies; regression test added
B2 span rule rejected exact 0.2 s span due to float differences -> 1e-9 s tolerance (no pilot window affected)
write_npz stores 0-d strings as 1-element arrays -> scalar_str reader (caught by validator)
manifest torch-version lookup imported torch and inflated peak memory -> importlib.metadata lookup, memory measured first

claims.note: Pseudo-targets are perceived tracks of one video (PILOT_SMOKE); results are pipeline diagnostics only.

limitations: PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_NON_INDEPENDENT: one PIE video, one scene group, 2,327 heavily overlapping windows from 84 tracks; no split; no generalization, cross-scene or research-grade claim; no ranking of baselines is statistically supported.
Targets are perceived YOLO11n + ByteTrack footpoints (pseudo-targets) with unmeasured detection/tracking error.
Errors are image-plane pixel distances: depth-dependent and affected by camera ego-motion; not metric.
B1 uses Task 2 one-frame (1/30 s) causal velocities with ~48 px/s per-axis jitter, which is amplified over a 1.5 s horizon.
Strict windows (all history and future observed) favour long, continuously tracked pedestrians.
No confidence intervals: windows are correlated and only one video exists; track-weighted summaries are reported alongside window-weighted ones.
deviations: added common-window comparison and per-horizon errors
baseline naming standardised: B0 zero velocity, B1 last valid causal velocity, B2 historical linear regression (kickoff-era protocol table order corrected in the hygiene pass)

acceptance.scope: framework and reference baselines validated on the pilot; no performance claim

recommended_next_task: P5.5 heterogeneous GATv2 + causal dilated TCN encoder (plain PyTorch), later evaluated with this evaluator against B0-B2; in parallel P5.2 data acquisition
